name: geodesign_robust
notes: Stage F2b robustness of the FIXED geographic layouts. Real geography; synthetic emissions and meteorology. The layouts and frozen alphas of a finished geodesign run (robust.layouts_from) are re-used verbatim and evaluated on the regenerated TEST ensemble (same seeds, noise and sigma, so matched rows are the main run's rows) under: unseen winds (declared nominal / declared true), a hidden wind error, a different boundary time profile, an omitted local facility source and an omitted external Gaussian, and a 250 m / 50 s truth block-averaged to the 500 m inference grid. Refinement stability re-selects greedy layouts on the 250 m model. Provisional simulation design, not field-validated.
